notes.note: Bruhn had a handy game with 28 touches and 8 marks. His best in three weeks but look for a good score this week against the Tigers at home.
Bruhn was quiet by his standards with 16 possessions.
Bruhn was good without posting a huge score. He did have 24 disposals and 4 marks and has a couple of easier matchups coming so should be good in the run home.
Bruhn was amongst the best for the Cats with his 27 disposals at 81% efficiency.  A good return to the team from him.
Left the game in the third term after a heavy tackle from Bedford and didn't reappear. Just the 13 disposals for him but reports are there was no serious injury and is a test for this week.
This is back to back over 100 for Bruhn for the first time this season with his 22 disposals.
Bruhn was much better as he more than doubled last weeks score and was one of just two over 100 for the Cats. He managed 26 disposals and hopefully he can continue this after his bye.
Quiet game for Bruhn as he had 11 disposals at 81%. This is now three games in the 50s in a row signalling this is the time to upgrade.
Bruhn did have 20 kicks and 3 handballs but with just 2 contested and a low efficiency of just 56% it didn't translate into a good SuperCoach score.
Bruhn returned to the side but it wasn't a great return with just 13 disposals and his lowest score since round 3. It wasn't a free flowing night for the Cats as many of their stars were below par.
Bruhn was listed as managed this week and was a late out for the Cats.
Bruhn finished with 29 disposals but it was the 6 langers and 58% efficiency that were the problem.
Bruhn got to his BE but only just. 15 disposals for him with 5 marks. He is on the verge of being one you need to move on and upgrade.
22 touches for Bruhn as his scoring seems to have dipped after last week's good outing.  Persist with him if you have bigger issues to deal with.
Bruhn was one of the shining lights for the Cats with 24 disposals at 70%. He looked good and it was a solid bounce back from last week's poor score.

Bruhn was missing early and while he was better in the second half he still posted his second lowest score of the season and his BE has now risen to 59 which means we have a decision to make as to whether we hold or trade.
Bruhn was great with 28 disposals and 7 tackles. He has had a couple over 110 now and hopefully we can see more of this.
26 disposals for Bruhn was a good outcome for owners with this being his second best score so far this season.

Bruhn had a head clash and broken nose in the first term and finished with just 64% time on ground and 15 disposals.  Write this one off and carry him through to next week although no disposals in the last term was a concern.
Bruhn was one that came into a heap of teams on the back of his preseason and opening round form and this game showed why with a great score. He is one we should bring in if we don't have him.
Bruhn showed that the preseason game wasn't a one off with a solid showing in the loss. He will be highly selected and one that you may not want to miss out on.
